batch_sampling: one hidden batch per entire measurement or rescue experiment, retained across all members and adaptive branches
batch_prior: known stratum-specific, independent of biological type before capture
channels_semantics: channels.tsv is prior marginal diagnostic only; batch_channels.tsv and batch_capture.tsv are authoritative joint model
capture_semantics: capture.tsv is prior marginal diagnostic; batch_capture.tsv authoritative jointly with batch_channels.tsv
